Name: Cottage Dream Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[center][b]IMPORTANT:[/b]
[i]I will NOT be adding or removing any parts of this map, unless they are game-breaking.
If you don't like x/y/z in this map, learn how to use Tiled and edit the map yourself. ♥

[/i]
[b]Features[/b]
• All grass is tillable 
• Designated areas for crops, animals and buildings
• Replaces the Standard Farm
 • For Stardew 1.5

[u][b]Requirements[/b][/u]
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher (latest version)
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets

[b][u]Recommendations[/u][/b]
•[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8203] Blueberry's Greenhouse Entry Begone[/url]﻿
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10019]Hippo's Farm Cave Variety[/url]﻿

[u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Cottage Dream Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Standard Farm 

[b][u]Changelog[/u][/b]
Replaced Trailer with a Playground
Config for a Fenceless Version
More flowery garden beds
[/center]
